title: Dr. Vinod Kumar Bassi v. The State of U.P. & Anr.
disposition: Interlocutory order (notice issued; further proceedings stayed till next date)
headnote: An interlocutory order in a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C., on the contention that a complaint-case was proceeded with without the enquiry under Section 202(1) Cr.P.C. (the accused and the complainant being in different districts). Notice was issued and further proceedings stayed till the next date; nothing was decided. This order has no connection with the Electricity Supply Code.

holding_units.topic: Interlocutory stay in a s.482 complaint-quashing petition
holding_units.holding: On the applicant's contention that the complaint was proceeded with without the Section 202(1) Cr.P.C. enquiry (applicant residing in Lucknow, complaint filed in Hardoi), notice was ordered and further proceedings stayed till the next date. No merits were decided.
